messages:
Mia Chen: Quick heads-up — bringing vq3b-int3 onto the canary pool for throughput tests. Noticed odd holdout leakage in the sampler overnight, tagging curation + label ops.
Owen Patel: Thanks Mia. Can you paste the failing sample examples?
Mia Chen: sure, a few long-form prompts are showing up in the micro-holdout (should be in production-only). Example: `User: summarize 20k token thread` — ended up in the canary holdout.
Tara Nguyen: That smells like the sampler keying on truncated fingerprints. We recently changed the token-normalize step.
Ashwin Rao: I ran a quick diff between fingerprint v1/v2 — ~0.6% overlap but concentrated on long ctx. Command I ran: ```sql
SELECT fp, count(*) FROM promptset_v2 WHERE len(tokens) > 4096 GROUP BY fp HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
label-ops-bot: FYI — labeler queue for micro-holdout is currently paused for `golden-refresh` maintenance until 16:00 PST.
Samir (ops): We can unpause for a targeted reassign if this blocks canary. ETA 30m to prepare short-lived slot.
Mia Chen: Goal is to avoid blind canary pass. If holdout has production samples we risk false regressions on model quality metrics.
Owen Patel: Proposal: 1) Snapshot current micro-holdout 2) Run de-dup pass with token-normalize v2 and truncated-hash 3) Push suspect subset to manual review (golden).
Tara Nguyen: Agree. Also add a quick heuristics filter for long prompts so we don't accidentally fingerprint on a tail token. I can push a patch to the sampler today.
Ashwin Rao: I can run quant smoke on the cleaned set once label-ops confirms reassign. I'll track BLEU/ROUGE and the new hallucination score.
label-ops-bot: Reassign request received: `micro-holdout-suspects` -> 12 items. Priority: high. Assigned to labeling team lead.
Mia Chen: If labeling will take >2h we need an interim canary with a stricter routing policy: route long prompts to legacy int8 model. Can someone add that fallback?
Samir (ops): I can add a routing rule: `if tokens > 4096 -> legacy-int8` for canary pool. Will deploy in 15m and notify.
Owen Patel: Also, we should update the golden set manifest and version it: `golden_v2026-04-07` — so we can roll back comparisons.
Tara Nguyen: I'll create the manifest and add provenance notes (sampler commit, de-dup script hash, labeling batch id).
Ashwin Rao: Once we have golden v2026-04-07 and the cleaned holdout, I'll run quant-int3 vs int4 regression and post a concise benchmark with per-prompt diffs.
Mia Chen: Thanks — action items: Tara create manifest + sampler patch, Samir add routing fallback, label ops finish 12 suspect items, Ashwin run comparative eval. Ping here when each is done. :thumbsup:
Owen Patel: If anyone needs the SQL I used or the diff script I can paste it here.
Tara Nguyen: Please paste the diff script, Owen — will help reproduce.
Owen Patel: ```bash
# diff fingerprints v1 vs v2 for long prompts
python tools/fp_diff.py --old fingerprint_v1 --new fingerprint_v2 --min-tokens 4096 --out suspects.csv
```
label-ops-bot: Labeling batch `micro-holdout-suspects` completed. 12/12 items labeled.
Mia Chen: Great — can we get a short sample of labeled results (just pass/fail + comment) into GDrive?
label-ops-bot: Uploaded summary to https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/xxxxxxxx (file: micro-holdout-suspects-review.csv)
Samir (ops): Routing fallback is live. Canaries now route long requests to legacy-int8.
Ashwin Rao: Kicking off quant-int3 vs int4 run on cleaned holdout and golden_v2026-04-07. Will post results in ~45m.
Mia Chen: Perfect. If regression looks clean we'll proceed with broader canary tomorrow. If not, keep the fallback rule and we'll triage.
Owen Patel: Thanks team. Note: follow-up doc in the eng-ml wiki with the sampler patch + reproduce steps would be great.
Tara Nguyen: I'll open a small PR with changes and link the ticket.
Mia Chen: Closing loop here once Ashwin posts bench. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:
